The wide swing of Will's pitch‐black blade... ......cleaved through Clair's form. Blown away by a powerful gust of wind, ......her human form crumbled in an instant, became a storm of golden flower petals, and was torn apart. After she was blown away, a golden heart remained in midair, but it too was swallowed by the vortex of wind and broke down into flower petals. The golden vortex swirled around the chapel...... Then, the swirl of petals gradually scattered out of existence......and vanished...... A few remaining petals danced around like snowflakes, and those final vestiges decorated the chapel beautifully. .........A beam of light lit the center of the stage.
